sections.title: Scaffolding creates a starter structure
sections.body: npm create vite@latest asks the create-vite package to generate starter files. Choosing the React template adds React, React DOM, the Vite React plugin, scripts, and sample source files. It is a starting structure, not a finished architecture. Read the generated files before deleting or extending them.

sections.title: Use the commands in the correct folders
sections.body: A clear flow is: scaffold the named folder, enter it, install declared dependencies, then start the development script. With npm, a direct React template command is npm create vite@latest my-react-lab -- --template react. The extra double dash passes the template option through npm. Follow the tool output because version-specific prompts can change.

sections.title: The development server serves modules
sections.body: npm run dev runs the local Vite server declared in package.json. Vite serves source modules to a modern browser, transforms JSX through the React plugin, resolves imported packages, and supports fast updates during editing. The localhost URL is a development address on your computer; it is not a public deployment.

sections.title: Prove the smallest project works
sections.body: Open the exact URL printed by Vite, confirm the starter page renders, edit one visible sentence, and observe the update. Read the terminal and browser Console for errors. Then stop the server deliberately with Ctrl+C and restart it. This proves the editor, files, terminal, Node, npm, Vite, browser, and port all connect correctly.

sections.title: Use evidence instead of setup guesses
sections.body: When setup fails, identify the layer before changing code. Read the terminal command and first error, confirm the current directory and versions, check the browser Network and Console, and trace the entry file to the root component. Make one small correction, rerun the same check, and record what proved the fix.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you debug a failure related to create a learning project with vite?
interviewQuestions.answer: Reproduce the smallest failure, confirm the current directory and versions when relevant, read the first terminal or browser error, trace the entry and root, and test one hypothesis at a time.

interviewQuestions.question: Which tradeoff in create a learning project with vite should a team decide explicitly?
interviewQuestions.answer: The team should match tools and boundaries to product needs, record version and deployment assumptions, and avoid treating a starter template as a complete production architecture.

commonMistakes.symptom: Every setup problem is described as a React error.
commonMistakes.cause: Browser, Node, npm, Vite, project files, and React responsibilities were mixed together.
commonMistakes.fix: Identify the failing layer from the command, URL, stack, file, or tool panel before editing.

commonMistakes.symptom: Commands work in one terminal but fail in another folder.
commonMistakes.cause: The current directory or active Node installation differs.
commonMistakes.fix: Check the path, package.json, lockfile, node -v, and npm -v in the same terminal.

commonMistakes.symptom: The starter template is treated as a complete production plan.
commonMistakes.cause: Scaffolding and build features were confused with routing, data, server, security, and deployment architecture.
commonMistakes.fix: Write product requirements and assign each responsibility to React, a build tool, a framework, the platform, or backend code.
